Sheet: Pre and Post Tax stock returns
In computing post personal tax returns, I use the highest marginal tax rates on dividends and assume that capital gains get paid every year (100% turnover ratio). Assuming that you are in a lower tax bracket or selling shares less often (extending the holding period) will lower the tax impact.
